subject: WRITE statement
notes: Rule (cite.py --check 14.9.51.4 'the information in the area referenced by identifier-1 is available, provided that identifier-1 is not one or part of one of the record descriptions subordinate to the file-description' -> OK 9)). Code: the FROM phrase emits only a MOVE that READS identifier-1, and the connector call receives a copy of the record-area image. Nothing writes back to identifier-1. Probe dir: out/probe/write-statement-p3/ (pinned adj-d1 cobol.exe). from1.cob: after WRITE R1 FROM WS-SRC, WS-SRC shows '[HELLO]'; after the indexed WRITE K-REC FROM WS-KSRC, WS-KSRC shows '[K01DATA1]'. The record-area half ('not available except as specified by SAME RECORD AREA') is GR4's and is decided there. No test is aimed at this rule, so test-ref is empty.
